final: WITH a AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id=t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id=ac.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total, cnt, total*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY region),0) AS share FROM a ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC LIMIT 10
